attacks.claim: The announcement copy contradicts the opt-in design it describes. It promises text alerts to every cardholder, but texts are opt-in only and juvenile cards never see the option. Publishing this on the library site, posters and e-newsletter at 10:00 would misstate the service to the whole public.
attacks.evidence: Announcement text says exactly: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs. "The option appears on adult and teen (13+) cards only; juvenile cards do not show it" and "texts start only after the patron replies YES."
